instruction: Fix two plain-folder workspace issues: (1) in apps/daemon/src/shadow-repo.ts, shadowGitEnv uses the reserved .local domain (shadow@cairn.local) instead of an RFC 2606 invalid domain (shadow@cairn.invalid); (2) in apps/server/src/services/build-merge-request.ts, requestMerge only reads plainFolder build state when the project directory is not a git repo, so plain-folder builds whose directory contains or gained a .git folder bypass the plain-folder in-place/merged/undone guards. Always check current.plainFolder whenever defined on the build.
